# moodle-cli 0.7.0-alpha.3

This prerelease fixes macOS credential persistence discovered during public-package end-to-end validation. It retains the complete 0.7.0 alpha feature set and the first-deployment stabilization from alpha.2.

## 0.7.0 alpha feature set

- Download one authenticated Moodle resource with `moodle download` or `moodle dl`, including atomic writes, overwrite protection, and structured receipts.
- Deploy and manage a private Cloudflare Worker MCP server with `moodle mcp deploy`, `status`, `login`, `connect`, and `remove`.
- Keep Moodle sessions encrypted in a Durable Object, renew them locally, and expose read-only Moodle tools over MCP `2026-07-28` with `2025-11-25` compatibility.

## Fixed in alpha.3

- Persist managed MCP credentials in the macOS Keychain through Security.framework instead of the `security` CLI password-prompt mode that stored an empty value.
- Pass credential payloads through stdin so access tokens and encryption keys never appear in process arguments.
- Treat empty Keychain entries created by alpha.2 as missing, allowing affected deployments to recover automatically.

## Validation

- Complete Node and Bun suites pass, including a real macOS Keychain write/read/delete round trip.
- Typechecking, CLI and Worker builds, npm package checks, installed-tarball smoke tests, generated-skill drift checks, and the compiled standalone smoke test pass.
- A disposable Cloudflare deployment from the packed release candidate completes all eight onboarding stages and validates liveness, authenticated readiness, MCP initialization, `tools/list`, and verbose CLI status.
- The disposable Worker is removed and existing Codex, Claude, VS Code, and Cursor configuration files remain unchanged.

The `alpha` npm dist-tag moves to this release. The stable `latest` dist-tag remains on `0.6.0`.
